rules.preserve_header_footer_key: Preserve headers, footer and current key placement; update only the editable key text when marker conventions change.
rules.reflow_policy: Review split and font fit as fixtures grow; never overflow the white body or alter the shell.
rules.score_orientation: Home goals first, away goals second; only Tiverton numeral red; W/D/L from Tiverton perspective.
rules.penalty_confirmation: Southern League explicit goalType penalty; corroborate reports where available; never infer from minute alone.
rules.timing_precedence: Preserve checked dashboard timing and confirmed local corrections where official league timing differs; flag conflicts.
rules.portland_correction: 17 Oct: Finn Roberts started; Koerner injured in warm-up and did not participate.
rules.last_minute_edits: Read live Canva first; compare to baseline, preserve manual edits and flag disagreements; update baseline only after successful save.
rules.styling: Alternating yellow/white rows, black header with white text, green on arrows, red off arrows, amber/red cards, Antonio.
rules.subtitle: SOUTHERN LEAGUE DIVISION ONE SOUTH RESULTS (UP TO {source_scrape_date_DD/MM/YY})

opponent_column_spacing.crest_placement: Vertically centred in each match row, in left gutter of opponent column. Preserve aspect ratio; move crests with their matching fixture.

rules.marker_readability: Use explicit native CAPT, GOAL and PEN text labels. Keep goal and penalty labels attached to their minutes with nonbreaking spaces. Match the editable legend. Preserve existing card and sub colours. Captain references purple, ordinary goals blue, penalties pink, including both editable keys.

event_colours.scope: Apply to every native CAPT label, GOAL plus minute, PEN plus minute, and corresponding complete key entries on both pages. Preserve surrounding text and existing substitution/card colours. Use range formatting, never palette Change all.

cell_spacing.purpose: Clearly visible six-point cell inset, keeping match-details text away from the score boundary. Preserve live spacing, table width, coloured event runs and user keys. Keep dates on one line; keep crests centred with their fixture rows.

rules.pending_row_policy: New matches must be appended using a native editable table row matching the existing table styling; never replace a completed fixture or rasterise. Larkhall remains pending until reliable source confirms outcome and lineup.

pending_fixture.render_note: Add a matching editable native table row when result and match events are verified. Do not overwrite Portland or insert misleading score; no native empty row currently exists.

pending_next_match.format: Clone exact styling of previous native editable table row; red Tivvy 3 in home-first score; goal blue; 64 PEN pink; captain purple; substitution on green and off red; preserve artwork; do not overwrite Portland

copy_rule: Resolve all table, cell, crest and legend targets again in the new issue copy.
